protocol_notes: Frozen locally before evaluating new results; not an external preregistration.
No test labels enter fitting, hyperparameter selection or representation selection.
Synthetic transfer fits shared time-indexed parameters on two training networks and evaluates two independently generated networks.
The second synthetic test network changes persistence, overlap and duplicate rate.
Real-data experiments evaluate disjoint states on known temporal topology, not unseen-network or future-event prediction.
Tail loss uses the existing code's top-ceil tail mean squared, with the actual selected count logged.
Causal switching uses only current validation/audit errors and previous selection; offline DP also sees future validation/audit errors.
Full H is a known-source reference and exact fallback, not a fitted model with an equal information budget.
No experiment is removed because its result is unfavorable.
